items.name: Baguette
items.description: A long, thin French loaf with a golden, crispy crust and soft, airy inside.

items.name: Ciabatta
items.description: An Italian flatbread with a crispy crust and light, open texture with large holes.

items.name: Gluten-free
items.description: Made without wheat or other gluten-containing grains. Suitable for customers with coeliac disease or a gluten intolerance.

items.name: Granary/seeded
items.description: A hearty bread made with malted wheat grains and seeds, giving it a nutty flavour and chewy texture.

items.name: Wholemeal/brown
items.description: Made with whole wheat flour, giving it a denser texture, nutty flavour, and higher fibre content than white bread.

items.name: White
items.description: Made with refined white flour. Soft with a light texture and mild flavour.

items.name: Bagel
items.description: A ring-shaped bread roll with a dense, chewy texture. Often topped with seeds.

items.name: Bap/roll
items.description: A soft, round bread roll. Light and fluffy, commonly used for sandwiches.

items.name: Wrap
items.description: A thin, soft flatbread used to roll around sandwich fillings. Also called a tortilla.

items.name: Sourdough
items.description: Made using a natural fermentation starter, giving it a distinctive tangy flavour and chewy crust.
